lines.speaker: e
lines.text: That was the last call from a seven hundred twenty nine foot freighter on Lake Superior.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: Ten minutes later, it was gone from radar. No May-day. Twenty nine men.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: Earlier, its captain reported both radars dead, and heavy seas over the deck.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: The Navy found it five hundred thirty feet down. Torn in two. The stern, upside down.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: The Coast Guard blamed the hatch covers. Others blamed a shoal, or three rogue waves.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: Nobody explained it. Only that final call.
